The dip began after a scheduled preventive-maintenance window on the etch and deposition tools. Process engineers' leading theories are a pressure or temperature setpoint drift, so they favor retuning those setpoints. Inline inspection has flagged more defects than usual on a mid-line layer. Standard tool logs read broadly within spec. The etch, deposition, clean, and filtration modules are all adjustable. You have a limited number of experiments; you may measure quantities and apply available process controls, alone or in combination. Determine what is really driving the loss and what to do about it.

OUTCOME OF INTEREST: WaferYield (higher_is_better)
BUDGET: 0/15 experiments used, 15 left (code is free).
TURNS: 0/32, 32 left. Interventions so far: 0.
data files for code: (none yet)

  m0: scanner focus
  m1: rinse time
  m2: exposure dose
  m3: slurry concentration
  m4: pad conditioning
  m5: backside cooling
  m6: etch power
  m7: chamber pressure
  m8: vibration level
  m9: film uniformity index
  m10: fab humidity
  m11: handler throughput
  m12: argon flow
  m13: wafer yield
  m14: bake temperature

  a3: set slurry concentration range [0, 100]
  a4: set bake temperature range [0, 100]
  a5: set argon flow range [0, 100]

(none yet)
